verdict.summary: Deep Zenodo + Figshare API pull found no downloadable CSV/XLS panel with Newtonian μ, measured needle d+L, barrel ID, Q, and friction-separated F_fluid. Figshare 32195520 is a real force/pressure XLSX (tissue IVI). Figshare 20800108 is delivery-time SI. Ackermann SI has AUC N·s stats only. Zenodo exact-phrase queries returned 0 relevant datasets.
verdict.implication: Phase D independent experimental validation remains blocked from Zenodo/Figshare repository sources alone.
